newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's IMI to launch one trln lire bond.
newsitem.headline: Italy's IMI to launch one trln lire bond.

text.p: Italian investment bank IMI SpA said it is to launch a 10-year, one trillion lire fixed-rate domestic bond issue.
Subscription opens next week and details of the coupon and placement agents will be announced on December 10, it said.
IMI launched a one trillion lire seven year, zero coupon domestic bond in May.

The new bonds, in five million lire denominations, will be priced at par with a due date of December 19. The offer will be open to the public on December 11 and 12 and the settlement date is December 18. The bonds will be quoted in Milan.
